messages:
Aisha K.: ok team, I'm dropping primary at the meridian handoff — taking notes below for whoever picks up late-window. will be reachable for 20m if anything spikes :wave:
Marcus L.: thanks — I'm secondary for the first hour. any known coverage gaps?
Aisha K.: two things: 1) the long-tail embedding job sometimes saturates sfo-gpu-pool around 03:00 UTC; 2) prefix cache warmers occasionally fail after deploy, causing latency blips.
Jin Park: noted. do we have an immediate mitigation for the cache warmers?
Aisha K.: yes — quick remedial steps in runbook. run: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/prefix-warmer` then check pods `kubectl get pods -l app=prefix-warmer` and `curl -sS http://prefix-warmer:8080/health`. full runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/OPS/Prefix+Cache+Warmers
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: high-rt spikes on endpoint /v1/embeddings in sfo - incident PD-8342 triggered 1908765400
Leah M.: I left a short checklist in the runbook page for a graceful fallback to the lighter quantized model if the pool is saturated — link: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/OPS/Embedding+Pool+Fallbacks
Ravi S.: for the quantized switch we do the policy toggle in Console -> Routes -> embd-prod -> Fallbacks. Can confirm the low-ram variant keeps latency under 120ms for most queries.
Marcus L.: if we're toggling fallback, make sure to annotate the incident ticket with `fallback=quantized_v1` and post to #incidents. also add metrics tag `fallback_trigger=true` so the dashboard shows it.
Aisha K.: coverage gap: no one on-call with GCP access for the sfo-cluster during 04:00-05:30 UTC window. Marcus can you confirm you have access?
Marcus L.: I only have read-only for GCP. Jin, can you or Ravi step in for any admin ops during that window?
Jin Park: I can be primary admin for 04:00-05:00 UTC. Ravi can cover 05:00-05:30 if needed.
Ravi S.: yep I can. leaving my escape hatch: if GCP console is flaky use `gcloud compute ssh` into bastion and run the following to check GPU usage:
```
ssh redwood-bastion && sudo nvidia-smi -i 0 --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,temperature.gpu --format=csv
```
Leah M.: quick pointers from runbooks (copy so it's top-of-mind):
- Prefix warmer restart -> wait 30s -> sanity curl /health
- If embedding pool CPU/GPU >85% for 3 consecutive mins -> trigger fallback to quantized variant and open ticket
- If KV cache blowup observed (errors 5xx with kv-cache tag) -> flip `kv_cache_read_only=true` in config map and restart service `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/kv-proxy`
Aisha K.: also if you see a steady error increase from a single customer id, throttle via console -> routes -> customer_id -> rate_limit (set 10rps) and notify CSE.
oncall-bridge-bot: Bridge created: https://meetings.redwood.com/bridge/1908765432 (auto-joins enabled)
Marcus L.: thanks, I'll join the bridge at :30. Aisha, leaving a short summary in the incident ticket before you go?
Aisha K.: done — summary pinned to PD-8342: "meridian handoff: primary -> Aisha K.; known risks: sfo embedding pool saturation, prefix-warmer flakiness; mitigations: restart prefix-warmer, fallback to quantized_v1, kv_cache read-only toggle."
Jin Park: one more: if fallback doesn't reduce latency within 5 mins, run the traceroute on the route handler and paste logs to the incident: `curl -sS http://router:8080/debug/trace | tee /tmp/trace.log`
Ravi S.: logging note: the `ops-agent` sometimes drops traces during heavy IO — if you suspect missing traces, set `OPS_AGENT_DEBUG=true` in the pod env and redeploy the single pod to avoid cluster-wide noise.
Leah M.: I'm tagging the two runbook links again for quick access: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/OPS/Prefix+Cache+Warmers and https://confluence.redwood.com/display/OPS/Embedding+Pool+Fallbacks
Aisha K.: thanks all — I'm handing off now. Marcus (secondary) -> Jin (admin) -> Ravi (late admin). escalate to infra@redwood.com if anything beyond our playbooks. :rocket:
Marcus L.: got it. logging into bridge.
Jin Park: on it, see you on bridge.
Ravi S.: standby.
oncall-bridge-bot: Note: handoff recorded by bot. Thread archived under oncall/meridian-handoffs/1908765432"
